## PulseCraft PPG — an open photoplethysmography teaching kit

Designed and built end-to-end during my visiting PhD period at **Khalifa University**, for the CMHS
Summer Internship Program 2026 (Biomedical Engineering & Biotechnology track).

Five hands-on PPG projects — activity recognition, caffeine response, relaxation biofeedback, a
voluntary-apnea SpO~2~ proxy, and live stress detection — with Arduino/ESP32 acquisition firmware,
a 3D-printable sensor case, Python data-collection and machine-learning pipelines, and a
no-hardware signal simulator.

Released open-source (MIT / CC BY 4.0) so any lab, course, or individual can build on it.
